item.title: ​​ 🚨 $6.3B Binance Hack: What Do We Know So Far? Around $6.3B in crypto assets w
item.description:
​​🚨 $6.3B Binance Hack: What Do We Know So Far?

Around $6.3B in crypto assets was reportedly drained from Binance's hot wallets. North Korea's TraderTraitor group, linked to Lazarus, is suspected.

Key Details:

• $3B in stolen assets reportedly frozen.
• $60M USDT deposited into Aave, with $44.6M WETH borrowed.
• EIP-7702 used to deploy a drainer contract, with a compromised DevOps laptop identified as the suspected entry point.
• Withdrawals suspended for up to 48 hours. Binance pledges to cover losses through SAFU and company funds.
• $135B held in tracked Binance wallets, making the estimated loss equivalent to 4.7% of assets.

📉 Market Reaction: BTC −2%, ETH −3%, BNB −6% over 24 hours, compared with BTC's 10% daily drop during the FTX crisis.
